subject: SOS: accelerated SOC 2 Type II evidence & bridge-letter request to clear Aurelia procurement
messages:
From: Katie Mason <katie.mason@aureliatx.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Torres <mike.torres@aureliatx.com>, procurement@aureliatx.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 07:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II / audit period clarification for Q4 renewal

Alex —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement is moving fast on our end but we have a hard requirement from our audit/compliance team: a current SOC 2 Type II report covering at least a 6-month audit period that overlaps Oct 1–Sep 30 (or a signed interim/bridge attestation) so we can complete our vendor risk assessment by end of week.

Our deadline: Oct 9 COB PST. If Redwood cannot provide the SOC 2 Type II report in time, we will accept a bridge letter signed by an executive plus (1) a short interim attestation of controls in place and (2) a list of evidence artifacts with owner contacts and delivery ETA.

Please confirm whether you can (a) upload the Type II report, (b) provide a signed bridge letter + interim attestation, or (c) propose an alternative acceptance path by EOD Oct 5.

Apologies for the rush — this is the gating item for our PO.

Katie
Katie Mason
VP, Procurement
Aurelia Therapeutics

[Attachment: Aurelia_Security_Request_20261005.eml]

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SOS - Aurelia procurement deadline (needs SOC2 Type II/bridge) — immediate sprint

Team — forwarding Aurelia's inbox ask. This is a live procurement cutoff: Oct 9 COB PST. They will accept bridge letter + interim attestation + evidence ETA if we can't produce the Type II report in time.

Key asks (they need answers EOD today):
- Can Security produce the current Type II PDF or confirm auditors will approve a limited disclosure (redacted) by Oct 9?
- If not, can Security/Legal approve a bridge letter + interim attestation we can send to procurement?
- Who owns each evidence artifact (network diagrams, change logs, IAM policy snapshot, patch schedule, recent vulnerability scan) and can deliver within 72 hours?
- Sales: are we comfortable with an interim commercial concession (short PO hold/credit) if needed?

I've attached the Aurelia request and a starter Bridge-Letter-Draft. I will put Katie/Mike on a 9:15am PST sync if we need to align live.

Attachments: Bridge-Letter-Draft.docx, SOC2-Evidence-Checklist.xlsx

Thanks — appreciate quick eyes.

— Alex Martinez
Enterprise Accounts, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOS - Aurelia procurement deadline (needs SOC2 Type II/bridge) — immediate sprint

Alex — putting this to the top. Short answer: we do NOT have an unsigned Type II PDF we can publish publicly; final report is with our auditor and there are redaction rules. We can, however, provide the following in <72 hours if we prioritize: 

1) Executive-signed bridge letter (Legal + InfoSec language) — I can draft controls language and Laura can route to Legal for sign-off.
2) Interim attestation (CISO) describing controls baseline and audit period coverage (dates + scope).
3) Artifact index with owners & firm ETAs (I will own: vulnerability scans + IAM snapshot; Laura will own change management logs; Karthik please own network diagrams and topology).
4) A secure upload link (S3 pre-signed) to deliver redacted artifacts to Aurelia Procurement — Legal will require MD control on access and retention.

Immediate blockers: need sign-off from Legal on bridge wording and a named signatory (CEO or VP Security). Also need confirmation of which audit period Aurelia requires (they said overlap Oct 1–Sep 30; clarify whether calendar or fiscal).

Action items I will execute today: draft bridge letter template, compile list of artifacts we can share, and contact auditor to confirm earliest release constraints. ETA for my deliverables: 24–36 hours for draft; final signed within 48–72 hours if Legal + exec sign quickly.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOS - Aurelia procurement deadline (needs SOC2 Type II/bridge) — immediate sprint

Team — thanks for the quick triage. Lore: please copy Legal (legal@redwoodinference.com) on the bridge letter draft and tag CEO for signature authorization. Procurement is strict; we should assume they'll accept the bridge + interim attestation if the artifacts and owners + ETAs are crisp.

Commercial note: be prepared to offer a short-term concession to avoid losing the deal (e.g., 30 days of credits or expedited onboarding). I will reach out to Aurelia exec sponsor (cc'd: Mike) to keep momentum while Security/Law finalize docs.

Next steps:
- Rishi: send draft bridge letter to Legal by 12pm PT.
- Laura: assemble evidence index (owners + 72h ETA) by 3pm PT.
- Karthik: prepare network diagram & topology export and identify reviewer by EOD.
- Alex: prepare DocuSign flow and PO-friendly language for procurement.

I am available on the 9:15am sync to escalate with CEO if Legal delays sign-off.

— Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Katie Mason <katie.mason@aureliatx.com>, Mike Torres <mike.torres@aureliatx.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II / audit period clarification for Q4 renewal — immediate artifacts + bridge letter (draft attached)

Katie / Mike — thanks for the clarity and the deadline. Attached is a draft bridge letter and our interim attestation template; Security + Legal are aligned to deliver signed docs and an artifact index with owner ETAs. We do not have a public unredacted Type II report that we can publish today; we will provide the signed bridge + attestation and the artifact package to meet your procurement gating criteria.

What we are delivering now: 
- Draft Bridge Letter (attached) — executive sign-off pending Legal.
- Interim Attestation (attached) — CISO-signed once Legal approves language.
- Artifact index (will include: vulnerability scans, IAM policy snapshot, change management logs, patch schedule, network diagrams) with named owners & ETAs.
- Secure upload plan (pre-signed S3 with strict access window) and retention plan per your request.

Requested confirmation from you:
1) Confirm audit-period requirement explicitly: must the report cover Oct 1–Sep 30 calendar-year overlap, or is Aurelia's compliance team referring to a different fiscal range?
2) Will your team accept redacted artifacts uploaded to an access-controlled bucket + a signed bridge letter and attestation for procurement acceptance?
3) If yes, please confirm the PO hold date (you mentioned Oct 9 COB PST).

We will open a DocuSign envelope once Legal confirms signatory and will provide the secure artifact link when items are uploaded. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/7892 — I will update status to 'security evidence in transit'.

Attachments: Bridge-Letter-Draft.docx, SOC2-Evidence-Checklist.xlsx
DocuSign (placeholder): https://docusign.com/prepare/placeholder-AU-7892

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we will treat this as high-priority to keep your procurement timeline intact.

— Alex Martinez
Enterprise Accounts, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198
